title: Rebate for redevelopment, remediation and reuse of contaminated properties known as brownfields.
officialText:
Owners who demonstrate that their site was contaminated and has been certified as remediated by the United States
environmental protection agency or the New York state department of environmental conservation, or has received a notice
of satisfaction from the New York city department of environmental protection, may receive a fee rebate as established by
rule.
